module: Unit tests of xlsxlib (Thomas Fischer, 2024). Each test loads `test_input_1.xlsx`, reads a sheet or a range and compares the result to the expected JSON file located in lua/common/libs/xlsxlib/tests/. If the expected file does not exist, it is created from the current result (with a warning: to be checked by hand). Launch: `rerequire('libs/xlsxlib/tests/tests').runTests()`.
notes: `runTests` creates the /junit-results/ folder and writes the report to /junit-results/xlsxlib-results.xml.
The tests use the libs/xlsxlib/tests/TestManager manager; names ending in `_shouldFail` must fail.
Uses the game's global functions serialize, jsonEncodePretty, writeFile, jsonReadFile, dumps, log and the engine's FS:fileExists.

runTests.desc: Creates /junit-results/ then runs all the tests of the Tests table via TestManager and writes /junit-results/xlsxlib-results.xml.

Tests.desc: Table of test cases (methods called by TestManager with a `context`).

test_nonExistentSheet_shouldFail.desc: Requests a nonexistent sheet; must fail ("Sheet not found" error).

test_firstSheet.desc: Reads the first sheet of the workbook (without a sheet name).

test_selectMixedAbsoluteRelative.desc: Selects a range mixing absolute and relative references.
